_rhythm: slots copied from the @carve__reveal reference cut list (8 cuts / 11.4s)
_note: v4 (2026-07-27): bas-relief master (take2, Thai-carving profile), strict watermelon-only palette, macros seeded from MID-RUNG stage_C so the reel never shows finished carving before shot 6, tip-work opening, 2 takes on money transitions (B->C, D->master) with cherry-picked windows, loudness pass on the mix. Transitions are Hailuo minimax start/end clips cropped 3:4 -> 9:16 and placed at media/m_<name>.mp4 by hand.
style_suffix: The wolf is carved in SHALLOW BAS-RELIEF into the watermelon rind, like traditional Thai fruit carving - nothing protrudes beyond the melon's curved surface. It is a carved watermelon, not a living animal: the carving never moves, blinks or breathes; only the knife and the hand gripping it move. Only watermelon colors in frame - dark green rind, pale green-white inner rind, cream pith, red flesh only where already visible; no grey, no black, no brown. Soft flat diffused light, matte natural texture, no glow, no airbrush. Subtle handheld micro-movement, shallow focus. Photorealistic, ultra-detailed. No text, no watermark.

shots.name: 01_wide_outline
shots.provider: hailuo start/end A->B, paring-knife tip work

shots.name: 03_brow
shots.prompt: The tip of a paring knife makes one short shallow fur stroke in the pale carved rind above the drawn eye - a small pale shaving curls off and falls. Brief contact, then the blade lifts away. The drawn line-art parts of the face stay flat and uncarved.

shots.name: 04_eyes
shots.prompt: The tip of a paring knife traces once along the carved edge of the brow beside the drawn eye, lifting a thin sliver of pale rind that curls and drops. Brief precise contact moments, the blade entering and lifting. The drawn line-art parts of the face stay flat and uncarved.

shots.name: 06_mouth
shots.prompt: PLACEHOLDER - Hailuo transition stage_D -> master (mouth excavation).

shots.name: 07_fangs
shots.prompt: The tip of a paring knife cleans the edge of one carved fang with a single short stroke - a fine sliver curls off and drops, juice glistening on the red flesh inside the mouth. Brief contact, then the blade lifts.

shots.name: 08_hero
shots.prompt: A cloth wipes once across the finished shallow carving, clearing shavings, and the hands turn the melon a few degrees to settle it centered for the hero reveal. The carving itself does not change.
